cases.name: Same-package calls across files
cases.rationale: Same-package function in different file should resolve exact call edge

cases.name: Imported function calls
cases.rationale: Project-local imported package call resolves exact edge

cases.name: Package aliases
cases.rationale: Explicit package alias 'b_alias' must resolve to pkg_b

cases.name: Value receiver methods
cases.rationale: Receiver type estimated across package boundary; resolved conservative when cross-package

cases.name: Pointer receiver methods
cases.rationale: Pointer receiver estimated from composite literal; resolved conservative across packages

cases.name: Interface dispatch with one known implementation
cases.rationale: Direct invocation on concrete pointer type resolves exact

cases.name: Interface dispatch with multiple possible implementations
cases.rationale: Ambiguous interface method dispatch falls back to conservative selector

cases.name: Recursive call graph (direct)
cases.rationale: Self-recursive call must resolve exact edge without infinite loop

cases.name: Mutual recursion
cases.rationale: Mutually recursive calls must terminate and resolve exact edges

cases.name: Call-depth boundaries at K=2, 3, 4
cases.rationale: Chained intra-package function calls resolve exact edges at each step

cases.name: Error propagation through wrappers
cases.rationale: WrapError returns error signature; ignored return value flagged if checked

cases.name: Named return values across helper functions
cases.rationale: Cross-package named return error signature resolved via function type

cases.name: Resource acquisition and cleanup in different functions
cases.rationale: Local acquisition closed in callee is flagged as leak due to intraprocedural limitation

cases.name: Resource ownership transfer through wrappers
cases.rationale: Acquisition in callee transferred to caller is not recognized by intraprocedural analyzer

cases.name: SQL construction through helper functions
cases.rationale: SQL taint generated in callee does not flow into caller's reaching definitions

cases.name: Shell command construction through helper functions
cases.rationale: Command argument assembled in callee does not flow into caller's reaching definitions

cases.name: Dynamic dispatch
cases.rationale: Interface parameter dispatch without concrete binding resolves conservative

cases.name: Missing dependencies
cases.rationale: Standard library or external package without registered model resolves EXTERNAL_OPAQUE

cases.name: Build-tag-dependent implementations
cases.rationale: File with build tags is parsed by standard AST parser unless tagged out by build system

cases.name: Generated code
cases.rationale: Generated code header parsed without panic; external fmt call is EXTERNAL_OPAQUE

cases.name: Incomplete type information
cases.rationale: interface{} field handled safely without type panic

cases.name: Unresolved external calls
cases.rationale: Local function call inside pkg_d resolves exact
